answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The ledge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the raven of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
